mapper.select: select case_id, source_flow, diagnosis_category, evidence_status, handoff_reason, requires_human_review, case_status, schema_version, create_time, update_time from ai_case_handoff order by create_time desc limit #{limit}

select case_id, source_flow, diagnosis_category, evidence_status, handoff_reason, requires_human_review, case_status, schema_version, create_time, update_time from ai_case_handoff where case_id = #{caseId} limit 1

select metric_key, count(*) as total from ( select case status when 0 then 'pending_review' when 1 then 'approved_return' when 2 then 'completed' when 3 then 'rejected' else 'unknown' end as metric_key from oms_order_return_apply where create_time >= #{fromTime} union all select case status when 'PENDING_REVIEW' then 'pending_review' when 'ACCEPTED' then 'accepted' when 'COMPLETED' then 'completed' when 'REJECTED' then 'rejected' when 'CANCELLED' then 'cancelled' else 'unknown' end as metric_key from ai_after_sales_application where create_time >= #{fromTime} ) as all_after_sales group by metric_key

select metric_key, count(*) as total from ( select case when reason in ('质量问题', '商品存在质量问题', '商品瑕疵') then '质量问题' when reason = '商品错发或漏发' then '商品错发或漏发' when reason = '商品与描述不符' then '商品与描述不符' when reason in ('七天无理由', '七天无理由退货', '不再需要商品') then '七天无理由' else '其他' end as metric_key from oms_order_return_apply where create_time >= #{fromTime} union all select case when reason in ('质量问题', '商品存在质量问题', '商品瑕疵') then '质量问题' when reason = '商品错发或漏发' then '商品错发或漏发' when reason = '商品与描述不符' then '商品与描述不符' when reason in ('七天无理由', '七天无理由退货', '不再需要商品') then '七天无理由' else '其他' end as metric_key from ai_after_sales_application where create_time >= #{fromTime} ) as all_after_sales_reasons group by metric_key

select case when status in ('PENDING', 'PUBLISHING', 'PUBLISHED', 'FAILED') then status else 'UNKNOWN' end as metric_key, count(*) as total from ai_after_sales_outbox where create_time >= #{fromTime} group by metric_key

select case when delivery_status = 'DELIVERED' then 'DELIVERED' else 'UNKNOWN' end as metric_key, count(*) as total from ai_after_sales_event_delivery where create_time >= #{fromTime} group by metric_key
